instrument: ChatGPT connected-GitHub blind-memory Judgment probe with bounded receipt-family de-dup preflight

judgment_reality_outcome_boundary.rule: Every retained lead is phrased as a contemporaneous hypothesis, expectation or signal-quality judgment. The probe does not assert that defensive ordering, inventory overhang, contract repricing or service-value behavior actually occurred at any named cutoff.

control_basis.coverage: phase, actor, metric, generic contemporaneous Judgment and explicit unknown leads
liner network planning/schedule reliability/blank sailings/capacity management
campaign-wide negative-space decision that P017-P020 materially cover container structural variables
independent challenge proposing inventory-bullwhip/destocking and spot-contract basis timing as potentially distinct Judgment families

preflight.reason: The sealed orientation already contains generic demand fear, repeated normalization forecasts, temporary-versus-structural liner economics, orderbook oversupply and a broad 2022 normalization thesis. P017-P020 own equipment, commercial booking/contract workflow, network reliability/capacity management and inland constraints. P143 therefore retains only expectation states about signal interpretation and timing that are not equivalent to those structural states.

new_judgment_categories.label: order_signal_amplification_vs_final_demand_judgment_state
new_judgment_categories.memory: At a historical cutoff, a participant could hold a hypothesis that bookings or purchase orders were being amplified by defensive inventory behavior such as safety-stock building, earlier ordering, front-loading or duplicate ordering, so observed order/booking strength might overstate durable final consumption. This is a Judgment about signal interpretation, not a claim that such behavior occurred.

new_judgment_categories.label: inventory_overhang_destocking_reversal_judgment_state
new_judgment_categories.memory: A distinct expectation state concerns whether accumulated pipeline or on-hand inventory could later reverse into destocking and weaken bookings/freight demand even if end-consumption did not collapse. The expected timing, magnitude and causal importance must remain uncertain until known-time Evidence is reconstructed.

new_judgment_categories.label: spot_contract_repricing_basis_rollover_judgment_state
new_judgment_categories.memory: Participants could separately judge that spot freight might normalize before annual or longer-duration contract economics reset, creating a temporary basis between headline spot indicators and contracted shipper cost or carrier realized pricing. Exact contract terms, renewal dates and realized basis require Evidence.

useful_refinements.label: carrier_revenue_shipper_cost_realization_lag_expectation
useful_refinements.memory: Financial realization may be expected to lag spot-market moves because contract mix, renewal timing, surcharges and volume mix can differ; this refines the spot-versus-contract basis Judgment rather than forming another standalone structural family.

useful_refinements.label: booking_signal_quality_confidence_state
useful_refinements.memory: Researchers should preserve how much confidence a contemporaneous participant placed in bookings/orders as demand signals when precautionary ordering was a live hypothesis; later cancellations or normalization must not be leaked backward.

useful_refinements.label: service_reliability_capacity_guarantee_value_judgment
useful_refinements.memory: A shipper or forwarder could value assured space/equipment and service reliability separately from the headline freight rate. P018/P019 already own the underlying allocation and reliability structures, so P143 keeps only the expectation/value trade-off as a refinement.

useful_refinements.label: goods_services_mix_persistence_judgment
useful_refinements.memory: A contemporaneous thesis could ask whether an unusual goods-versus-services spending mix would persist or normalize. This refines the orientation's generic demand-normalization Judgment and must not be stated as an observed causal share.

useful_refinements.label: sourcing_inventory_policy_persistence_judgment
useful_refinements.memory: Participants might debate whether sourcing, buffer-stock or inventory-policy changes would remain durable after acute logistics stress. Exact corporate actions and persistence require Evidence; this remains a Judgment refinement.

useful_refinements.label: normalization_clock_decomposition
useful_refinements.memory: The expected clocks for congestion relief, spot freight, contract renewal, inventory correction, schedule reliability and realized carrier/shipper economics should be represented separately rather than compressed into one normalization date.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact shipper or retailer inventory positions and safety-stock targets at historical cutoffs
which named shippers or forwarders believed duplicate ordering, front-loading or destocking was material and when those beliefs changed
exact spot-versus-contract spreads, contract durations, renewal cohorts, surcharge mechanics and carrier realization lags
exact goods-versus-services mix, sourcing-policy changes or causal contribution to freight demand at any cutoff
later realized cancellation, destocking, contract-reset, rate, profitability or reliability outcomes
negative_space: claim-scoped reconstruction of contemporaneous shipper/forwarder inventory and order-signal judgments
known-time chronology of contract-renewal and spot-versus-contract expectations
known-time separation of booking signals from later cancellations/consumption outcomes
actor-specific revision history for normalization clocks
stop_reason: The bounded Judgment questions are classified. Three expectation states survive after structural de-dup; service reliability, financial realization and goods/sourcing persistence are refinements. Further progress requires claim-scoped, known-time Evidence and would risk hindsight leakage.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only contemporaneous Judgment/Expectation orientation. It establishes no Reality, later Outcome, exact shipper behavior, inventory level, contract rate/term, causal share, carrier revenue, service value, sourcing shift or named-actor belief.
